comments.body: Messed up two mandatory courses in one rather chill semester for similar reasons. Retook them next semester plus a lot of other courses,  totalling like 40 ECTS. Passed everything with these two courses both around 5.25 and finished my BSc in time 😊 it took a lot of motivation and luck. Looking back, I'm not sure if the stress was worth it 🙃
comments.author: chiubicheib
